title: Color Palette Generator
h1: Color Palette Generator — Tints from One Hex
seoTitle: Color Palette Generator — Tints from One Hex
description: Build a five-step tint and shade palette from one hex color. Steps are mixed toward white and black locally, with hex codes you can copy.
intro: Start with a base hex color. The tool makes two lighter tints, the base, and two darker shades so you have a small UI palette.
blurb: Generate five hex tints and shades from a single base color.
howItWorks: The base color accepts 3- or 6-digit hex, with or without #.
Lighter steps mix the base with white; darker steps mix it with black.
Each step is written as a six-digit hex code, from lightest to darkest.
examples: #0F766E produces a teal scale with the base in the middle.
#fff is treated as white, so darker steps are grays.
A three-digit value such as #39c is expanded before mixing.

faq.q: Is this a perceptual color scale?
faq.a: No. Steps are simple RGB mixes toward white and black. They are even in channel space, not in lightness perception.
The output lists hex codes one per line. Copy them into your stylesheet; this page does not write files.
